best_human.provenance: Grassl's BKLC page reports a [68,15,24] construction. It gives a construction chain through a [68,18,24] parent and a 15-dimensional subcode.
best_human.evidence_state: published_lower_bound; matrix not retrieved or independently reproduced

best_public.evidence_state: published table lower bound with a saved Magma BKLC database witness independently verified by rank and exact enumeration; construction attribution is not named
best_public.origin_type: unknown unless attribution is stated in source/provenance

best_reproduced.provenance: AI implementation of classical systematic-generator simulated annealing, 60 iterations, seed0; not a historical human record
best_reproduced.ai_provenance: Generated by this project classical annealing baseline, seed0, fixed60iterations. Saved matrix has exact minimum distance19.
best_reproduced.evidence_state: saved fixed-count seed0 local search witness, all32767nonzero words independently checked

published_derived_human.provenance: Three direct-sum copies of the public RM(1,4) [16,5,8] construction, followed by 20 zero coordinates.
published_derived_human.ai_provenance: Generated in this task from the public Reed-Muller evaluation construction; not claimed as a published [68,15] record.
published_derived_human.evidence_state: saved witness, rank, and distance independently verified exactly

survey_scope_note: Best public means the strongest same-parameter result in the cited checked sources. This is not a claim that every public source has been surveyed. Unmatched parameters are listed separately.
frozen_human_baseline_type: reconstruction of a published human method; weaker than best public record
